title: Umbel store backup manifest, version 1
description: manifest.json of a directory store-backup writes: one space's embedded stores, copied as files, each with its size and SHA-256. store-restore reads it (D214). Memory's key file and index are never in it.

memoryKeys.description: Present when memory.sqlite3 is: the key file is never copied (D82)

memoryFts.description: Present when memory.sqlite3 is: memory's index is rebuilt on its first open
